L107: Show Champion Chart winners (2024)
L108: ---
L109: The Show Champion Chart is a 【39†record chart】 on the South Korean 【40†MBC M】 【41†television music program】 【42†Show Champion】. Every week, the show awards the best-performing 【43†single】 on the chart in the country during its live broadcast.^{【44†[1]】}^{【45†[2]】}
L110: 
L111: In 2024, 36 singles reached number one on the chart and 27 acts have been awarded a first-place trophy. "【46†Chk Chk Boom】" by 【47†Stray Kids】 is the only song to achieved a 【48†triple crown】.^{【49†[3]】}
